title: Arrays: array_filter + array_map
prompt:
Write squareEvens(array $numbers): array that keeps only the even numbers and returns their squares, as a list re-indexed from 0.

  squareEvens([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]) → [4, 16, 36]
  squareEvens([1, 3]) → []

Watch out: array_filter() keeps the original keys, so [1 => 4, 3 => 16, 5 => 36] is NOT the same as [4, 16, 36].

hints: array_filter($numbers, fn($n) => $n % 2 === 0) keeps the elements where the callback returns true.
array_values() throws away the gaps in the keys so you get a clean 0,1,2,... list.
solution:
<?php
function squareEvens(array $numbers): array
{
    $evens = array_filter($numbers, fn(int $n) => $n % 2 === 0);
    $squares = array_map(fn(int $n) => $n * $n, $evens);
    return array_values($squares);
}
